description:
A major VPN outage has occurred. A Problem record has been created ('Global VPN Gateway Connection Failure'), and several user tickets have come in. Your goal is to identify the 3 requests related to the VPN outage and associate them with the Problem record.

Start at the Problems list. Open the 'Global VPN Gateway Connection Failure' problem. Use the 'Incidents' or 'Associated Requests' tab to find and attach the relevant requests. Do NOT attach unrelated requests (e.g. Printer or SAP issues).
